items.title: Fairphone Reveals Fairbuds 2: Modular, Repairable TWS Earbuds With LDAC
items.summary: Fairphone will officially unveil the Fairbuds 2 on October 14, 2026, retaining a modular design with seven fully replaceable parts. The second-generation earbuds add Sony's LDAC high-resolution codec alongside SBC and AAC, and launch at 119 euros in Europe and 119 dollars in the US.

items.title: Huawei Launches FreeBuds Neo with 30dB Adaptive ANC
items.summary: Huawei officially released the FreeBuds Neo on October 1, 2026, a youth-focused noise-cancelling earbud with a dual-path active noise control architecture delivering an average 30dB cancellation depth. It features a Turbo driver, up to 2.3Mbps lossless audio, spatial audio and a gaming low-latency mode.

items.title: Omdia: TWS Shipments Slip 0.7% While Open-Ear Segment Jumps 12%
items.summary: Industry tracker Omdia reports Apple shipped 16.8 million TWS devices in Q2 2026, up 1.2% year over year and holding a 20.5% share as the total market contracted 0.7%. Open wireless stereo (OWS) shipments rose 12%, led by Shokz at 1.1 million units with 107.9% growth, and are forecast to reach 90.5 million by 2030.

items.title: Nothing and CMF Debut Ear (3a), Buds Pro 2 and Clip Pro in Nepal
items.summary: Chaudhary Group launched three Nothing and CMF audio products in Nepal on September 25, 2026, with availability from September 27. The lineup spans ANC true-wireless earbuds, the dual-driver CMF Buds Pro 2 with a Smart Dial, and the open-ear CMF Clip Pro, priced from 8,599 rupees.

items.title: AI Open-Ear Earphones Market Projected to Hit 4.1 Billion by 2032
items.summary: A new market report values the AI open-wearable-stereo earphones category at 1.25 billion US dollars in 2025, forecasting growth to 4.1 billion by 2032 at an 18.5% CAGR. Bluetooth 5.3 and above led connectivity revenue in 2025, with Shokz, Oladance, EarFun, Anker Soundcore and Huawei among the profiled vendors.

items.title: Digital Trends Names Sony WF-1000XM6 Best Wireless Earbuds of 2026
items.summary: Digital Trends' 2026 earbuds guide ranks the Sony WF-1000XM6 as the best overall, praising redesigned drivers, four microphones per bud and class-leading ANC, with the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2nd Gen and Apple AirPods Pro 3 also top picks across premium, budget and open-ear categories.

items.title: Pixel Buds Pro 2 Review: Tiny Earbuds With a Direct Line to Gemini
items.summary: Google's Pixel Buds Pro 2 pair an 11mm driver with the Tensor A1 chip, Silent Seal 2.0 ANC and hands-free Gemini access, priced at 229 dollars. The review finds a compact secure fit and strong sound, but notes weaker ANC versus class leaders and limited appeal for iPhone users.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 vs Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro: 2026 TWS Showdown
items.summary: A head-to-head comparison pits the 278-dollar Sony WF-1000XM6 against the 170-dollar Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro, both with LDAC and adaptive ANC. HearWiki scores the Sony 87/100 for sound and ANC and the Soundcore 84/100, highlighting the latter's stronger call quality and value.

items.title: Android Central's 2026 Earbuds Guide Highlights OnePlus Buds 4 Value
items.summary: Android Central's 2026 buying guide spotlights the OnePlus Buds 4 as a top budget pick around 80 dollars with flagship-class tech, alongside the Google Pixel Buds Pro 2, Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 with heart-rate tracking, and the Technics EAH-AZ100 for audiophiles.

items.title: BestPick.guide Ranks AirPods Pro 3 Best Wireless Earbuds of 2026
items.summary: BestPick.guide's 2026 comparison places the Apple AirPods Pro 3 at the top with a 4.9/5 score for its H3 chip, FDA-cleared hearing-aid mode and 36-hour battery, followed by the Sony WF-1000XM6 and Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2, with the Nothing Ear (a) named best mid-range.
